text:
[LFAC.1.1] Every schema picks a lifecycle via the optional
`scope` clause on its header. Four values are admitted per
[LSCP.1.5]: `explicit`, `logical`, `ttl <duration>` and
`activation`, and `logical` and `ttl` may carry the `ambient`
modifier. When `scope` is omitted, the schema
defaults to `scope explicit` per [LSCP.1.4].

This section covers `logical` and `ttl`; `explicit`,
`activation`, and `ambient` live at [LSCP.2].
